title: Experience Sri Lanka with Nuwara Eliya
highlights: Discover Sri Lanka’s charm, from Nuwara Eliya’s lush tea estates to Kandy’s vibrant cultural heritage and Colombo’s lively cityscape.
Pay your respects at Seetha Amman Kovil, a revered Hindu temple in Sri Lanka, where you can explore its connection to the epic Ramayana.
Admire Ramboda Falls, a multi-tiered cascade nestled in lush greenery, offering a tranquil escape in Sri Lanka’s highlands.
Stroll along Galle Face Green, Colombo’s lively seaside promenade, and enjoy the stunning ocean with vibrant sunset scenes.
Witness the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, where Buddha’s venerated tooth is enshrined in a beautifully ornate shrine.
overview:
About the Tour:
Sri Lanka’s abundance of flora and fauna means it has beautiful nature trails, with stunning vistas and waterfalls, ancient ruins, beautiful beaches, and amazing wildlife, the island nation has many other stories to uncover.
Begin your tour with the Nuwara Eliya find yourself in the misty mountains rising into the clouds, hillsides covered with paddy fields and tea estates and the occasional peacock or deer crossing your path. As you move towards to lazy charm clinging on to the hills and floating by the gushing waves makes is a perfect destination to venture, explore, and contemplate Kandy is defined by calmness and serenity. Plunge into Colombo’s enticing street food scene, eat like a local, and immerse yourself in the sights, sounds and aromas of the whirling Pettah Bazaar and boasts a rich colonial heritage, featuring a melting pot of races, religions and cultures.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Transfer to Nuwara Eliya | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Sri Lanka! Upon arrival at Colombo airport, get transferred to Nuwara Eliya on a scenic drive through Sri Lanka's lush landscapes. Upon reaching Nuwara Eliya, check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of your day at leisure. You can head out to explore the city on your own and visit attractions like St. Clair’s Falls, nestled in lush tea country. Also, you can ascend the Ambuluwawa Tower and soak-in the panoramic views of Sri Lanka’s highlands. Later, return to your hotel on your own.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, board your transfer to explore the city on a sightseeing tour. Begin with a visit to the Hanuman Temple and soak in its serene atmosphere. Continue to Ramboda Falls and admire its cascading water against a backdrop of lush greenery. Then, pay your respects at the Seetha Amman Kovil and stroll through the lush Hakgala Botanical Gardens. Also, visit the serene Gregory Lake, where you can opt for boating and explore Victoria Park After an amazing day, get driven to your hotel.

items.title: Full Day Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis

days.title: Transfer to Kandy | Half Day Kandy Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Post check-out, get transferred to Kandy. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and relax. Later, you'll be taken on a sightseeing tour of Kandy. Begin with a visit to the Bahiravokanda Vihara Buddha Statue and soak-in the panoramic views of Kandy. Next, witness a diverse collection of over 4,000 plant species at the Royal Botanical Gardens. Continue to the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, a sacred Buddhist site that houses a tooth relic of Buddha. After an amazing day, get driven to your hotel.

items.title: Half Day Kandy Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis
The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic

days.title: Transfer to Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, after check-out, get transferred to Colombo. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and relax. Later, you'll be taken to explore the city on a sightseeing tour. Start with a visit to the Lotus Tower and take-in the panoramic views of Colombo’s skyline. Next, admire the stunning architecture of the Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple. Also, soak-in the lively atmosphere of the Pettah Floating Market and explore more of the city’s attractions. Later, get driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Full Day Colombo Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check-out from your hotel and get driven to the Colombo Airport. Once there, board your flight back home, this marks the end of your amazing Sri Lanka trip!
